beats: Guide the bird through a brief spirit-maze prelude.
Use books to answer the first room’s three riddles: Thursday, the empty chair, under the pillow. Choose twelve years to make Wick appear.
Follow him into a distorted second room. Read its four associations and answer its bed riddles.
Find Wick through the pusher and teleporter maze; return to the small bedroom.
data.consequences: Wrong or abandoned riddle runs restart only their sequence; completed earlier phases stay completed. No combat, item cost or real-time twelve-year wait.

questions.question: What is the origin of the false bedrooms?
Does the answer “twelve years” have a literal chronological meaning?

description:
A bird reaches a sleeping child; two false bedrooms lead into Wick’s projected maze before Mother’s call restores the ordinary room.

No authoritative explanation of the false rooms, curse or elapsed years; the optional Water curse leaf is unstable dream text.
